title: Are There Sharks in Madeira's Waters?
description: Yes. Madeira lists 67 confirmed species of sharks, rays and chimaeras, but most sharks live far offshore or deep down, and swimmers rarely see one near shore.
heroAlt: A blue shark swimming in open, deep blue ocean water far off the Madeira coast
keywords: are there sharks in Madeira's waters
is it safe to swim in Madeira sharks
